checks.title: Report leak check
checks.summary: no crawled league, draft, team or user name (764 seen, ≥ 10 chars) appears in the report; watch list for check:leaks: 4021 identities (322 draft-id, 844 league-id, 567 league-name, 543 other-id, 184 team-name, 1244 user-id, 317 username) from 1436 raw captures, git-ignored

issues: Sleeper sends previous_league_id as the string "0" (not null) in 3/250 sampled 2026 leagues, and that league doesn't exist (GET https://api.sleeper.app/v1/league/0 → HTTP 404) — evidence: https://api.sleeper.app/v1/user/{userId}/leagues/nfl/2026 → [].previous_league_id — options: treat "0" (and any all-zero ID) exactly like null, i.e. no previous season, in the Phase 1 adapter (this probe does).

Sleeper settings.type has a 4th value, 3 = guillotine ("chopped": the lowest scorer is eliminated each week), in 28/250 (11%) sampled 2026 leagues; CLAUDE.md §4 leagueType only has redraft, keeper and dynasty, and these leagues have no playoff_teams (28/28) — evidence: https://api.sleeper.app/v1/user/{userId}/leagues/nfl/2026 → [].settings.type, [].settings.last_chopped_leg; https://api.sleeper.app/v1/league/{previousLeagueId}/transactions/{week} → [type=chopped] (47 in 6 finished seasons) — options: (a) reject guillotine leagues at import for the MVP with a clear message; (b) import as redraft with a warning that weekly elimination isn't modeled.

Sleeper playoff_week_start is 0 in 1 sampled 2026 league(s) that aren't guillotine leagues ({"redraft, in_season, playoff_teams 7":1}), so their fantasy playoff weeks can't be read from settings — evidence: https://api.sleeper.app/v1/user/{userId}/leagues/nfl/2026 → [].settings.playoff_week_start — options: (a) treat 0 as "not set" and assume the most common start (week 15, 188/250 leagues) with an Import Report warning; (b) ask the user for the first playoff week.

Sleeper has best-ball leagues (settings.best_ball = 1 in 8/250 sampled 2026 leagues; points = potential points for 54/62 (87%) teams), which CLAUDE.md doesn't mention — evidence: https://api.sleeper.app/v1/league/{previousLeagueId}/rosters → [].settings.fpts vs ppts — options: (a) import them normally (the engine already values optimal lineups) and say "best ball" in the Import Report; (b) reject them for the MVP.

Sleeper supports playoff re-seeding (playoff_seed_type 1 in 27/250 sampled 2026 leagues; in 3/3 informative finished brackets seed 1 then played the lowest remaining seed), but CLAUDE.md §8 only says to seed by wins, then points-for — evidence: https://api.sleeper.app/v1/league/{previousLeagueId}/winners_bracket → [r=2] pairings vs seeds from https://api.sleeper.app/v1/league/{previousLeagueId}/rosters — options: (a) re-seed after each round in the simulator when playoff_seed_type = 1; (b) ignore it (it only changes who meets whom after round 1).

Sleeper rosters[].settings.division keeps division numbers after divisions are turned off: ≥ 2 distinct values in 2 of 37 finished seasons with settings.divisions 0 or missing — evidence: https://api.sleeper.app/v1/league/{previousLeagueId}/rosters → [].settings.division vs https://api.sleeper.app/v1/league/{previousLeagueId} → settings.divisions — options: read divisions (and division seeding) only when settings.divisions > 0 (this probe's seeding check does).

Sleeper position limits live in settings.position_limit_{pos} (position_limit_def, position_limit_k, position_limit_qb, position_limit_rb, position_limit_te, position_limit_wr; 13/250 sampled 2026 leagues), which CLAUDE.md §2.3's settings list doesn't mention; the rosters checked fit a cap on the active roster with IR exempt (0 of 38 limits exceeded on active rosters; 5 leagues over a limit only through IR players) — evidence: https://api.sleeper.app/v1/league/{previousLeagueId}/rosters and https://api.sleeper.app/v1/league/{leagueId}/rosters → [].players/reserve/taxi with positions from /players/nfl vs settings.position_limit_{pos} — options: (a) map them to LeagueSettings.positionLimits and enforce them on the active roster (IR and taxi exempt) per CLAUDE.md §7; (b) only warn on the trade card until more leagues confirm the IR exemption.
decisions: Sleeper trade-deadline rule for Phase 1 (proposed): trades are open while the league's settings.leg ≤ trade_deadline, not the /state/nfl week — no trade completed after leg D in 6 leagues that traded at the deadline; 10/39 completed trades finished in the NFL week after their leg (a league's leg advances only at its weekly waiver run); 3 of 7 leg-D trades completed during week D's Sunday/Monday games (no lock at kickoff); on this probe's Tuesday run /state/nfl already said week 4 while last_scored_leg was 3 in every in-season league, so the /state/nfl week can run a week ahead of the league's leg.

Sleeper tradeReview mapping (proposed): 'league_vote' when settings.veto_auto_poll = 1 (3/3 such trades had a veto poll), otherwise 'none' (with the poll off, 16/24 trades in leagues with trade_review_days ≥ 1 completed within 24 h); veto keys missing (75 2026 leagues) → 'none' with an Import Report warning until verified; 'commissioner' is never produced (no approval step in the data).
Sleeper currentWeek comes from /state/nfl (week); settings.leg lags until the league's weekly waiver run, and settings.last_scored_leg is the last completed week.

Sleeper omits settings keys freely; Phase 1 defaults for missing keys (from this sample): league_average_match missing in 6 → unverified (assume 0); best_ball missing in 72 → 0 (verified); veto_auto_poll/veto_votes_needed missing in 75 → 'none' (unverified).

Evidence rule for this item: a code value is ✅ only with ≥ 3 independent leagues (distinct 2026 leagues; earlier seasons of the same league don't count) and none contradicting, or ≥ 10 with ≤ 10% contradicting; below that it is ⚠️.

Sampling: snowball through league member lists, at most 5 new leagues per user so a few very active accounts can't dominate; previous seasons chosen greedily so every value of each code is covered where available. Every ordering uses a random salt kept only in data-local/ (git-ignored), so the committed code can't reproduce which public leagues were sampled.

Crawled leaguemates' IDs (league, user, draft) are registered with the Redactor so no console line or report can show them; display names and league names are never stored in the trimmed records, only keyword flags; every identity in the raw captures goes to a git-ignored watch list that check:leaks loads; and the report is checked against every name seen before anything is printed.
questions: Guillotine leagues (settings.type = 3, 28/250 (11%) of the sample) eliminate the lowest scorer each week: reject them at import for the MVP?
Sleeper's no-deadline value: trades after week 14 were seen in only 1 league(s) with trade_deadline 99: treat trade_deadline ≥ 18 as "no deadline"?
With divisions, Sleeper seeded division winners first in 2/2 informative league(s) (below the 3-league minimum): model seeding that way for leagues with divisions?

Reconcile with probe:sleeper A.tradeReview: should Phase 1 map Sleeper tradeReview from veto_auto_poll (1 → 'league_vote', else 'none') rather than from trade_review_days, given that with the poll off 16/24 trades with trade_review_days ≥ 1 completed within 24 h?
Sleeper position limits appear to exempt IR (seen in 5 leagues): enforce them on the active roster only (players minus reserve and taxi), per CLAUDE.md §7?
